limitations_and_boundaries: Female TauP301S mice showed subtler neurodegeneration at 9 months of age, and effects of C3KO could not be resolved.
TauP301S mice from the cohort did not show robust impairment in Morris water maze, so effect of C3KO on cognitive impairment could not be assessed.
